# modules/core — engine-wide primitives with no dependencies (LUR_ASSERT, later
# Guid, Log). Header-only, pure C++; every other module may depend on it.
add_library(lur_core INTERFACE)
target_include_directories(lur_core INTERFACE Public)
target_compile_features(lur_core INTERFACE cxx_std_20)
add_library(lur::core ALIAS lur_core)

# ── Build fingerprint (#112's gate; #164 moved it here) ───────────────────────
# Lur::BuildFingerprint() is regenerated BY EVERY BUILD, not at configure time. It used to be a
# compile definition from EngineFlags.cmake, and a cached configure-time value cannot answer the
# question the fingerprint exists to answer: generators reconfigure only when a CMakeLists.txt
# changes, so `commit; gradlew installDebug` stamped the APK with the previous commit and two phones
# built from identical source reported badbuild=1 (twice on 2026-07-31, #164). An uncommitted edit
# was invisible in the other direction — a false negative exactly where the gate is meant to bite.
#
# Shape: a custom target that always runs, writing a one-line TU (only when the value CHANGES, so an
# unchanged tree costs nothing), compiled into a tiny static lib. Being a real library means CMake
# orders it against consumers automatically — no add_dependencies for a future consumer to forget —
# and a fingerprint change relinks one object instead of recompiling everyone.
get_filename_component(_lur_fp_repo "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../.." ABSOLUTE)
set(_lur_fp_src "${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/Generated/LurBuildFingerprint.cpp")
set(_lur_fp_args
    "-DLUR_FP_REPO=${_lur_fp_repo}"
    "-DLUR_FP_CONFIG=${LUR_CONFIG}"
    "-DLUR_FP_OUT=${_lur_fp_src}"
    -P "${_lur_fp_repo}/cmake/BuildFingerprint.cmake")
# Seed at configure time so the source exists before the first build (and so a generator that
# inspects it up front sees a valid TU rather than an empty placeholder).
execute_process(COMMAND ${CMAKE_COMMAND} ${_lur_fp_args})
add_custom_target(lur_build_fingerprint_gen
    BYPRODUCTS "${_lur_fp_src}"
    COMMAND ${CMAKE_COMMAND} ${_lur_fp_args}
    COMMENT "Stamping build fingerprint (git HEAD + dirty + ${LUR_CONFIG})"
    VERBATIM)
set_source_files_properties("${_lur_fp_src}" PROPERTIES GENERATED TRUE)
add_library(lur_buildfp STATIC "${_lur_fp_src}")
target_link_libraries(lur_buildfp PUBLIC lur::core)  # for the declaration it must match
add_dependencies(lur_buildfp lur_build_fingerprint_gen)
add_library(lur::buildfp ALIAS lur_buildfp)
